parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of a bucket, typically made of stainless steel for strength and durability. It is an arched strip attached to the bucket body at two pivot points.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, distributing the weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can rotate or pivot around its attachment points to move up and down for carrying or resting positions.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the bucket, made of durable plastic. It forms the cylindrical container that holds liquids or solids.
parts.Functional_description: The base body serves as the primary container for holding materials such as water, sand, or other substances.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a fixed, non-moving part that provides structural support and containment for the bucket.
